key_insight: RenalTransLSTM combines LSTM and Transformer layers to better predict acute kidney injury early across multiple time horizons in ICU patients.
clinical_relevance: The model may help clinicians flag AKI risk sooner and support targeted decision-making using routinely collected EHR data.
method: Trained on 48-hour ICU histories from MIMIC-IV.
Predicted AKI at 6-, 12-, and 24-hour lead times.
Compared against SVM, XGBoost, LSTM, TG-LSTM, and Transformer baselines; used Integrated Gradients and counterfactual analysis for interpretability.
evidence_signal: Using 61,735 ICU admissions, the model achieved AUROC above 0.90 and F1-scores up to 0.85, with better overall performance than the benchmark models.
watch_item: Performance was shown on retrospective EHR data, so external validation and careful integration into real-world ICU workflows are needed before deployment.
paper_title: RenalTransLSTM: Multi-Horizon Prediction of Acute Kidney Injury in ICU Patients using a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer Architecture
